name: Knowledge bases
summary: Register a Foundry Index (knowledge base) referencing a customer-owned Azure AI Search index and query it through a BYOM-routed agent.
description: Verified live 2026-07-15 against the ai-gateway-pe-testing environment (which only has APIM-routed model connections — no direct AOAI deployments): `project.indexes.create_or_update()` with an `AzureAISearchIndex(connection_name=..., index_name=...)` successfully registers the index as a project-level knowledge base, and an agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-prefixed can consume it via the AzureAISearchTool.
notes: Contrary to earlier suspicion: the KB registration API does NOT require a Foundry-native model deployment on the account. It only wraps an Azure AI Search connection + index name; retrieval flows through the search tool at query time, which itself works with a BYOM-prefixed orchestrator.
